profile.headline: Lead Developer at CVS Health
profile.summary: A user-focused engineer dedicated to building the best products for both the business and end users. Passionate about understanding the bigger picture rather than just short-term results. Continuously seeking better ways to solve problems and drive improvements—not just individually, but as a team. I thrive on collaboration, sharing knowledge, and working together to develop innovative solutions. I deeply care about my team, actively listen to their ideas, and strive to create an environment where we all grow, improve, and succeed together

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Woonsocket, Rhode Island, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Contributes to solution design and architecture discussions, collaborating with architects and senior engineers
• Works with the team to align goals, share technical insights, and support decision-making.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to the overall technical direction and innovation
• Mentors team members, fostering growth and knowledge sharing.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
• Developed project plans and defined technical roadmaps 
• Led and coordinated team efforts to ensure successful project execution.
• Managed team members, providing guidance and support.
• Gathered and analyzed requirements to align development with business needs.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop new features for internal signing application 
•	Manage internal service desk to delegate tickets to developers and support 
•	Refactor legacy code for existing PHP applications
•	Perform usability and user testing and troubleshooting new and existing applications including integration features  
•	Manage and maintain MySQL database for Advertising Department

positions.title: UX Designer Intern
positions.description:
• development of a website that focus on online payments. 
• primary and secondary research, as well as creating design insights and personas.
• performed usability and user testing

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
• Mobile application utilizing Arduino device
• Track blood alcohol level and prevent driving under the influence.
• Create and design entire iOS application.

positions.title: Project Proposal Intern
positions.description:
• Assist Aramco-Cogen IPP Project Proposal Team
• Conduct proposals/contracts to build power plants in Saudi Arabia
• Manage communications among 20 departments including approximately 200 workers
• Understand the basics of engineering and its applications to the company

positions.title: Sergeant
positions.description:
• Director for Protocol of Visits and Foreign Missions
• Surveillance of traveling of North Korean spy suspects
• Monitor Air Force One from the threat of terrorists

positions.title: Supervisor
positions.description: • Supervised students for TOFEL and SAT

projects.title: PVT
projects.description:
• Consolidating and modernizing 10 systems to enhance user experience. 
• Creating wireframes to analyze existing tools and define the new system’s behavior.
• Setting up a completely new tech stack for the development team.

projects.title: Mobile OSP
projects.description:
• Developed a store-facing application for generating signs, labels, and activating price changes.
• Consolidating multiple systems into a unified platform for streamlined printing.
• Collaborating with multiple departments to understand legacy systems and integrate them into the new system.
